result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure **universal access to quality education**—because education is the foundation for solving nearly every other global challenge.

Education empowers individuals to break cycles of poverty, fosters critical thinking to combat misinformation, promotes gender equality, and cultivates empathy and innovation. It would give every child, regardless of background, the tools to shape their own future and contribute meaningfully to society.

What about you? If you could change one thing, what would it be?
